| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / Interface Management Procedures / NG Setup |
| Tags | negative |
| Verdict class | FAIL |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.7.1.4 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: added in V15.2.0 (Void in V15.0.0 and V15.1.0), worded for PLMN Identity IEs; Rel-16: reworded to the PLMNs/SNPNs form in V16.9.0; Rel-19: V19.0.0 adds that the AMF text applies to an AIOTF; the quoted sentence is unchanged)
- TS 38.413 9.3.1.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: Misc cause "Unknown PLMN" renamed "Unknown PLMN or SNPN" in V16.5.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-NGSETUP-UNKNOWN-PLMN.md).
